title: Flight controllers at the radio van
description: Two soldiers — flight controllers, Larry says, the same job he held — pose on the steel steps of the big riveted van where Larry did his radio operations. A power cable runs from the van to a field generator; CONEX containers, one with a red cross panel, stand in the background.
researchNotes: Larry's own account (Memories comment, 2026-08-15; archived as data/recollections/giscus-vn-0011-c18032554.json), confirming the survey's hypothesis that this is his operations van — the exterior of the interior seen in VN-0014/VN-0015. 'Flight controller' as Larry's own word for the job strengthens the aviation-operations picture of the unit. The two men are not yet named — interview goal; their name tapes are magnification targets.
